about: Claude prices in USD per million tokens, read by tools/departments/context-load.mjs. One row per model id; a model priced by prompt length has bands (upTo = the largest prompt, in tokens, the band covers; null = no limit). Every row carries its source and the date it was read. Change a price here, nowhere else.

cache.source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-caching (Which TTL each request gets: 'Claude Code requests the one-hour TTL only on a Claude subscription within your plan's included usage'; overage drops to five minutes). Transcripts of this project carry cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens on every write (measured 2026-11-01).
